load_yolo_annotations: load YOLO annotations from image and annotation directories with optional mask support and OBB format
save_yolo_annotations: save a DetectionDataset as YOLO-format annotation text files to a specified directory
yolo_annotations_to_detections: convert YOLO annotation lines into Detections objects with optional masks and oriented bounding boxes
detections_to_yolo_annotations: convert Detections objects into YOLO-format annotation strings with optional polygon approximation from masks
save_data_yaml: save a data.yaml file containing number of classes and class names for YOLO dataset configuration
